topic: Facility sensor data duplication and standardization
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the complexity of facility virtual sensors, noting that some facilities act as both sources and targets for session data. This setup can lead to duplicated or complex traffic reporting.

It was noted that while this duplication previously caused stepped increases in traffic, the current system handles it by simply combining own and virtual traffic streams.

A key concern is the lack of standardization when sensors are moved (transferred). When a sensor is relocated, the source/target dependencies must be updated accordingly. The process needs improvement to prevent data inconsistencies, such as facilities being listed as sources for many others but having no physical box installed.

Regarding data processing, it was confirmed that metrics calculation will take time and that the dataset remains in progress.
decisions: The system requires a mechanism to standardize sensor placement and dependency management when sensors are moved.
action_items: Implement a notification or history log for changes related to facility virtual sensors/boxes.
